title: Chapter 2936 - 171: Carving the Life Formation_2
content:
Chapter 2936: Chapter 171: Carving the Life Formation_2

Lugu remained silent.

Mo Hua looked at Lugu and asked, "Do you... have any dissatisfaction?"

Lugu still remained silent, then shook his head a moment later, bowed to Mo Hua, and resolutely said:

"If one day, Lugu dies on the battlefield, I ask Divine Blessing to grant me the blessing to turn my corpse into an immortal general. Let me, after death, fight alongside my brothers. With a decayed and rotting body, serve Divine Blessing, conquer the lands, unify the Great Wilderness, and forge eternal glory..."

Mo Hua’s eyes showed a look of surprise, and after a moment, he nodded slightly with a complex expression and said:

"I agree."

Lugu knelt before Mo Hua and solemnly said, "Lugu, thank Divine Blessing for fulfilling my wish."

...

In the following days, Gao Du formally became the Great Chieftain of the Gao Tu Tribe, working for Mo Hua.

The first thing he did was capture the former Great Chieftain of the Gao Tu Tribe, cut off his head, and presented it to Mo Hua to demonstrate his loyalty.

In the Gao Tu Tribe, there can only be one Great Chieftain.

Now, Gao Du is the duly appointed Great Chieftain by Divine Blessing, and the previous Great Chieftain must not exist anymore.

Otherwise, it would disgrace the prestige of Divine Blessing.

Mo Hua acknowledged Gao Du’s "loyalty."

After that, Gao Du led the Gao Tu Tribe in advancing for Mo Hua, flattening all the large and small tribes of the entire Third Grade Lu Yu Mountain Realm, unifying the entire region.

All the Barbarian Slaves were liberated by Mo Hua and incorporated into the Divine Slave Tribe.

And all the tribal leaders were also "cleansed" by Mo Hua.

If one believes in the Divine Lord, submits to Divine Blessing, and vows to follow the teachings of the Divine Lord henceforth, mercy can be granted.

If one remains obstinate and does not comply, their sins will be judged accordingly.

Those with minor sins are demoted to civilians, while those deeply sinful are executed immediately.

Thus, Mo Hua conquered and "transformed" the Third Grade Lu Yu Mountain Realm, incorporating it into the unified territory of the Divine Lord.

Later, during the time of unity in the Mountain Realm and the rest period for the Divine Blessing Army, Mo Hua found a secluded and quiet valley within the Lu Yu Mountain Realm for himself.

He prepared to carve the Twelve Scripture Gluttonous Spirit Corpse Formation on himself right there.

...

Lu Yu Mountain Realm.

Bone Miasma Mountain.

Within a hidden cavern in the mountain, Mo Hua sat cross-legged, surrounded by a dense formation.

This is a place Mo Hua specifically chose using the deduction of heavenly secrets, concealed in mystery, not leaking cause and effect.

Meanwhile, Dan Zhu and Lugu were guarding outside the cave.

The Third Grade Holy Beast Big Tiger and a group of Tiger Demons led by the Third Grade Dangling Eyes Fierce Tiger were also guarding Mo Hua outside.

This is a location of following fate and law on the path of Divine Blessing, extremely secluded, untouched by cause and effect, with exceedingly tight security, and Mo Hua’s calculations were exceedingly thorough.

Because this is his Core Formation, the most crucial step.

He intended to draw the Twelve Scripture Gluttonous Spirit Corpse Extremist Formation on himself, as his Lifebound Formation.

This action forms the foundation of Core Formation, the key to advancing to Foundation Establishment Peak, and concerns the success and future of his Tao Cultivation.

Similarly, this was a result Mo Hua achieved after enduring innumerable hardships and enduring prolonged suffering.

For this, Mo Hua was shrewd in scheming and plotting in the Great Wilderness, devoting much effort and planning for a long time.

Now, he had finally reached this point.

He should feel excited for this.

However, at this moment, Mo Hua’s emotions were somewhat cold.

Because divinity had already surpassed his humanity, he was already somewhat unable to feel any emotional fluctuation from his success and failures.

This matter had both advantages and disadvantages.

The disadvantage was Mo Hua knew his humanity had waned a bit more.

The advantage was that with weakened humanity and cold emotions, he attained absolute calmness.

What he was about to do next was a very "dangerous" and difficult task, involving extremely complex and precise cutting and manipulation of his own body’s flesh, blood, meridians, and bones.

Any emotional fluctuation would affect his mind, disturb his Divine Thought, and further interfere with his manipulation.

There should not be even a trace of emotional fluctuation.

Anticipation, excitement, elation, tension, unease, apprehension... these are all undesirable.

One must possess the absolute rationality and absolute calmness akin to a "deity."

Mo Hua slightly closed his eyes, resting his mind.

After a quarter of an hour, he opened his eyes, with a dazzling golden light in his eyes, his divinity awe-inspiring.

Then, Mo Hua took out two bottles, tightly sealed with glazed jade.

The jade bottles contained the most crucial, extremely precious Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures for forging the Wooden White Gold Jade Bone:

The essence of Wood White, and the marrow of golden jade.

Just like the forging method of Wood White Gold Jade, these were also procured by the Taixu Sect Master from the Bai Family, with great effort for Mo Hua.

Every drop extremely precious.

Using the marrow of golden jade to enhance the bone quality, making the skeleton as hard as golden jade. Only then can his bones serve as the formation media of the Ultimate Formation.

With the essence of Wood White, merged into Blood Qi, transforming blood into ink, to draw the formation. Only then can the ink, blood, formation, and bone thoroughly integrate as one.

At the same time, the essence of Wood White, with its inherent essence of "wood," can effectively complement the "wood" used for "locking blood" in the Wood Rejuvenation Formation.

Thus, forming a complete closed loop.

Wooden White Gold Jade Bone, Wood Rejuvenation Formation, Taotie Spirit Pattern.

Among the three, a common underlying logic is established, binding them together, forming Mo Hua’s Lifebound Formation System.

Mo Hua realized he might have practiced slightly crookedly again.

He had once again turned something simple overly cryptic and complex.
